net|dhcp_lease_timers|logic|&&->|||b1e1c.why: Equivalent: after the default repair above it, every lease of 3 s or more has renewal = floor(s/2) >= 1, rebinding - renewal = ceil(s/2) - ceil(s/8) >= 1 and rebinding < s, so each conjunct of the return is true and && or || answers the same.

net|dhcp_lease_timers|relation|<-><=|019.why: Equivalent: the repaired timers are strictly ordered for every lease of 3 s or more (renewal = floor(s/2), rebinding = s - ceil(s/8), whose difference is at least 1), so < and <= cannot differ.
